claims.statement: Levent Alpöge announced a purported RH proof and an extension to Dirichlet GRH, developed with Claude.
claims.proof_obligation: Identify the exact final Lean theorem and check that it is equivalent to standard Dirichlet GRH.
claims.verification_note: First pass inspected the author note p. 1. Task 02 identified all five Main declarations and their types in a pinned mirror. The semantic correspondence to classical Dirichlet GRH remains under investigation.

claims.statement: The original note links a formalization purported to encode the asserted result in Lean.
claims.proof_obligation: Acquire and hash the exact archive, pin its toolchain, reproduce the build, audit axioms, and compare the terminal theorem to Dirichlet GRH.
claims.verification_note: Note p. 1 footnote links fourteen parts. No local archive build. See data/reproductions.json for Sutherland’s independent build, module replay and nanoda verdict, and for Deicyde’s source and challenge CI results.

claims.statement: Iterated theta lifts appear in the author's announced development narrative as a proposed arithmetic mechanism.
claims.proof_obligation: Locate a precise lift iteration lemma; verify the claimed length, normalizations, errors, and noncircular transition to arithmetic estimates.
claims.verification_note: Alpöge note p. 4 timeline items 8–10 describe iterated lifts; no quantified lemma checked.

claims.statement: Ravi Vakil publicly announced Alessandro Masullo's proposed proof of GRH and linked a manuscript.
claims.proof_obligation: Establish exact scope and version of the manuscript's main theorem and identify its complete proof dependency chain.
claims.verification_note: Announcement and manuscript introductory material inspected; this does not verify the proposed proof.

claims.statement: Masullo's manuscript proposes using modified function spaces, orbital decompositions, and trace methods to constrain zeros.
claims.proof_obligation: Check definitions, operator domains, completeness/basis claims, convergence, trace interchange, and the derivation of the zero-location conclusion.
claims.verification_note: Manuscript sections and pp. 519–522 inspected; theorem 13.3.1.2 has a missing statement and an unresolved reference. Full proof audit pending.

claims.statement: An exact intermediate trace or Weil-form identity might connect an automorphic arithmetic bound to a localized spectral representation.
claims.proof_obligation: Precisely define the common distribution and spaces, state the map between them, prove boundedness/uniformity, and search for counterexamples.
claims.verification_note: Unproved project hypothesis. Masullo's test-function restriction φ(C_F¹)=0 excludes nonzero Weil-style autocorrelations; a straightforward positivity bridge is unavailable.

claims.statement: The manuscript's Chapter 13 currently lacks the written statement of Theorem 13.3.1.2 and contains an unresolved theorem reference and instructions to state and prove the main theorems.
claims.proof_obligation: Locate a revised complete terminal theorem, then check its statement and dependencies before treating it as a GRH proof.
claims.verification_note: Directly inspected physical PDF p. 522; this is a gap in the written presentation, not a proof of mathematical falsehood.

claims.statement: The proposed trace formula is stated for test functions vanishing on C_F¹; the author says this excludes nonzero Weil-positivity autocorrelation test functions.
claims.proof_obligation: Formalize the precise test-function compatibility question; justify any alternative positivity or bridge identity without assuming GRH.
claims.verification_note: Inspected manuscript §1.7.2 and Theorem 12.5.1.1 (physical pp. 35–36 and 519). Source statement verified; no general GRH consequence proved.

claims.statement: A source-used Euler-factor nonvanishing lemma from the submitted ClaimStrip.lean has been independently reproduced in Mathlib with the exact theorem statement.
claims.proof_obligation: Audit the next source-used consumer Claim.prim_zero and then isolate a nontrivial quantitative arithmetic lemma; this basic factor bound is not a hard GRH step.
claims.verification_note: Pinned source hash and signature matched. Independent Lean 4.33.1/Mathlib build passed 3578 jobs; #print axioms lists only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; three boundary and character controls passed.

claims.statement: The three submitted Dirichlet zero-location and right-half-plane nonvanishing formulations are equivalent, and imply Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis, using established Mathlib analytic facts.
claims.proof_obligation: Distinguish formal equivalence between the Lean propositions from complete equivalence to every classical meromorphic GRH convention; check boundary zeros for imprimitive factors and principal pole guard.
claims.verification_note: Independently compiled conditional implication and equivalence proofs in Lean 4.33.1 with pinned Mathlib; standard three axioms only. No proof that any GRH proposition itself holds.
